name.done.5: Bravo, {name}! The guests think it is wonderful.
name.help.1: {name}, come quickly! An animal needs you.
ask.name: What is your name?
parents.name: Name
parents.key.hint: Only needed for a name the game does not know yet. The key stays on this device.
say.free: You finished all the levels! The kangaroo is here too. Build whatever you like!
say.soon: More animals are on their way. Build whatever you like for now!
say.level.1: Let's build a pen. Then an animal will come!
say.level.2: Here are the pigs. Make them happy!
say.level.3: Now the cows. And keep the pens clean!
say.level.4: Time for guests! Lay a path from the entrance.
say.level.5: The guests are hungry. Put down a food stall!
say.level.6: Now something to drink for the guests.
say.level.7: Happy animals have babies. Save some coins too!
say.level.8: Guests sometimes need the toilet. Build one!
say.level.9: Chickens sleep in a nest. And the guests want to sit down.
say.level.10: The duck wants water. Make three kinds of animals happy!
say.level.11: The rabbit sleeps in a den. After this we go to the savanna!
say.level.12: Welcome to the savanna! The zebra wants sand. And the guests want ice cream.
say.level.13: The giraffe eats leaves. The park is getting big: hire some staff!
say.level.14: The lion is strong. Build a stone wall!
say.level.15: The camel likes sand and rocks. Put down some flowers too!
say.level.16: The rhino is strong and wants mud.
say.level.17: The hippo wants water and a stone wall.
say.level.18: The elephant is the biggest. Put down bins for the guests!
say.level.19: The ostrich sleeps in a nest. Pick up the litter!
say.level.20: The cheetah is fast and strong. Build a stone wall!
say.level.21: The gazelle jumps around. Watch out: animals can get sick!
say.level.22: Welcome to the jungle! The monkey climbs. Build a high net!
say.level.23: The parrot can fly. It wants a high net too.
say.level.24: The tiger is strong and sleeps in a den.
say.level.25: The gorilla is very strong and eats leaves.
say.level.26: The crocodile wants water and a stone wall.
say.level.28: The peacock shows its beautiful feathers.
say.level.29: The toucan has a big beak and likes fruit.
say.level.30: The sloth is very slow. It likes to hang in a climbing tree.
say.level.31: The panther sneaks around. Watch out: an animal might escape!
say.level.32: Welcome to the ice! The penguin wants snow and fish.
say.level.33: The seal loves to swim. Give it water and fish.
say.level.34: The polar bear is strong. Build a stone wall in the snow!
say.level.35: The reindeer wants snow, hay and a stable.
say.level.36: The wolf howls at the moon. It sleeps in a den.
say.level.37: The arctic fox is as white as snow.
say.level.38: The brown bear lives in the forest and eats fish.
say.level.39: The yak has a thick, warm coat.
say.level.40: The snowy owl can fly. Build a high net!
say.level.41: The walrus has long tusks. And now to faraway lands!
say.level.42: The flamingo is pink and likes to stand in the water.
say.level.43: The tortoise is slow and wants sand.
say.level.44: The otter swims and eats fish.
say.level.45: The beaver builds a lodge. It wants water.
say.level.46: The pelican catches fish with its big beak.
say.level.47: The koala sleeps in a climbing tree and eats leaves.
say.level.48: The red panda eats bamboo and loves to climb.
say.level.49: The lemur has a long tail with stripes.
say.level.50: The bison is big and strong. This is the last level!
say.pen: The pen is ready! It is called {name}.
say.taken: {The} is going to the shelter. Take good care of your animals!
say.born: A baby was born! Its name is {name}.
say.grown: {name} has grown up and moves to another zoo. You get 2 coins!
say.moved: Bye {name}! Have a good trip to your new zoo.
say.escaped: {The} has escaped! Tap it and put it back in the pen.
say.tip.keeper: Choose Staff and put a feeder or a cleaner in the park. Then we will help you!
say.hired: I will help you feed and clean!
alert.health: {The} is sick. Tap it and call the doctor!
alert.enclosure: The fence is open! Close it.
alert.wall: {The} is strong. Build a stone wall!
alert.net: {The} can get over the fence. Build a high net!
alert.broken: The fence is broken! Grab the hammer and fix it.
carry.full: Your hands are full. Find a bin!
alert.herd: {The} likes to live in a group. Put {herd} together!
alert.space: {The} needs more room. Make the pen bigger!
say.nogate: Your staff cannot get in. Build a gate in the fence!
say.staff.how: This is how you hire staff: choose Staff, put a feeder or cleaner in the park, and build a gate in every pen.
guide.staff.title: Hiring staff
guide.staff.2: Pick a feeder or a cleaner and tap in the park, outside the pens.
guide.staff.3: Use the Fence button to build a gate in every pen. Then your staff can get in.
guide.staff.4: Each worker costs 2 coins per hour. Tap a worker to send them home.
say.decor.new: New: put trees, flowers and rocks in your park! Almost every level adds something.
say.fun.new: New: toys and plants! Every animal has its own favourite.
cheer.2: You take great care of the animals. Well done!
cheer.4: What a lovely day in the park!
cheer.5: Your park is getting more beautiful every day!
cheer.6: I am proud of your zoo.
cheer.8: The till is ringing nicely. Good job!
alert.clean: The pen is dirty. Grab the broom and sweep up the poops!
host.food: The guests are hungry. Put a food stall next to the path!
host.drink: The guests are thirsty. Put a drink stall next to the path!
host.toilet: The guests need the toilet. Put a toilet next to the path!
host.sad: The guests are bored. Show them happy animals!
host.litter: There is litter on the path. Grab the picker and put it in a bin!
host.nopath: The guests cannot get there. Lay a path to it!

host.busy.drinkstall: The drink stall is too busy. Add another one!
host.busy.toilet: There is a queue for the toilet. Add another toilet!
host.busy.icecream: The ice cream stall is too busy. Add another one!
host.busy.playground: The playground is full. Add another playground!
host.busy.bench: All the benches are taken. Put down a few more!
cash.short: Not enough coins. Clean up poop or wait for guests!
say.pen.color: Tap the pen and pick a colour for the fence!
wallet.hour: The time. Every hour the workers get paid.
cash.wage: There is not enough money for wages. The workers are waiting.
say.hired.feed: I will fill the troughs. That costs 2 coins per hour.
say.hired.clean: I will sweep the pens and pick up litter. That costs 2 coins per hour.
